title: Tamsin and the Vow
author: Jude Fairweather
blurb: Ansel Okafor, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
